protocol: frozen Track 1 protocol (track1/manifest_track1.json, commit acb14d4f) unchanged: tasks, splits, startup, per-step ML-II fits to B80, straddle/margin, leakage guard, ledgers, endpoints, failure rules

WHOLE_E1_GUARD_STRADDLE.guard: if the paid (log whole, label) pairs are not separable and the logistic slope (C=1e6) is <= 0, u = log(111 um), the engine's single-class default; otherwise identical to WHOLE_E1_STRADDLE

arm_scope.WHOLE_E1_GUARD_STRADDLE: all R3_NEW runs; on R3_OLD / R1_POOLED only the runs in which arm A has >= 1 non-positive-slope step (phase 2, run in (task, repeat, fold) order while the round cap allows; any not run are listed). Elsewhere D equals A by construction.

not_run_and_why: arm D on repeats 1-4 (it would push the round above 15,000 scalar fits); C3; any simulator job

endpoints.primary: R3_NEW BA-AULC ACTIVE - G3 on repeats 5-8 (Week 18 repeat bootstrap, 4000, seed 0)
endpoints.summary: repeats 1-8 (Track 1 caches for 1-4 + this extension), same contrasts
endpoints.secondary: R3_OLD, R1_POOLED; q20, specificity, sensitivity, short-K sensitivity, Brier, AUC (AULC); QTT with the frozen definition (target = G3's mean BA at B40/B80 over the repeats analysed); guard activations; learned-threshold mechanism

hypotheses.X-H0_fidelity: Arms A and C reproduce the Week 18 DEV caches (phase3/depth3 E1; phase2 G3|mlii|margin) on repeats 5-8 at every grid budget <= 80: max |p_new - p_cache| <= 1e-4. Their contrasts then equal the historical values listed under historical_expectations.
hypotheses.X-H1_primary_replication: R3_NEW BA-AULC (grid 16..80 step 4), ACTIVE_E1_STRADDLE minus G3_MARGIN, on repeats 5-8 is > 0 (repeat-bootstrap mean). Basis: repeats 1-4 +0.057 [-0.007, +0.115] (per repeat +0.062, -0.032, +0.067, +0.132). No magnitude predicted.
hypotheses.X-H2_target_ablation: R3_NEW BA-AULC, ACTIVE minus WHOLE, on repeats 5-8 is > 0. Basis: repeats 1-4 +0.070 [+0.030, +0.110]. No magnitude predicted.
hypotheses.X-H3a_guard_identity: In every run in which arm A has no non-positive-slope step, arm D (WHOLE + guard) is identical to arm A: the same paid sequence and the same test probabilities (max |dp| = 0). A code-level check of the ablation.
hypotheses.X-H3b_guard_effect: R3_NEW BA-AULC, WHOLE + guard minus WHOLE, on repeats 5-8 is > 0. Basis: the reversed-slope trap (only paid negative = the late negative, whole 312 um) caused all six long WHOLE episodes on repeats 1-4, and the historical WHOLE threshold reached 200 um in 7 of 20 R3_NEW folds of repeats 5-8 (historical_expectations). No magnitude predicted.
hypotheses.X-H3c_remaining_target_effect: R3_NEW BA-AULC, ACTIVE minus (WHOLE + guard): the part of the ACTIVE-WHOLE difference not removed by the guard. No directional expectation.
hypotheses.X-H4_old_pooled: R3_OLD: |ACTIVE - WHOLE| < 0.01 and ACTIVE - G3 > 0 (repeats 1-4: +0.001 and +0.030). R1_POOLED: ACTIVE - G3 >= WHOLE - G3 (repeats 1-4: +0.005 vs +0.003).
hypotheses.X-H5_threshold_mechanism: ACTIVE E1 never reaches u >= 200 um on R3_NEW (repeats 1-4 maximum 188.9 um); falsified by any such step. In every WHOLE R3_NEW run with a u >= 200 um step, the late negative was paid before the first such step (temporal precedence only).
hypotheses.X-H6_eight_repeat_summary: Descriptive: ACTIVE - G3 and ACTIVE - WHOLE on R3_NEW over DEV repeats 1-8 (repeat bootstrap, 8 repeats). No expectation on whether the interval excludes 0.
hypotheses.X-H7_secondary: q20, specificity, sensitivity, short-K sensitivity, Brier, AUC and QTT are reported without expectations.

decision_rule: C3 protocol draft: written (NOT executed) only if X-H1 holds (repeats 5-8 point estimate > 0) AND the repeats 1-8 point estimate of R3_NEW ACTIVE - G3 BA-AULC is > 0; otherwise HOLD (no C3 protocol). Spending C3 remains the owner's decision.
